summary: Implementation plan for: (1) Multi-Destination Database Backup & Disaster Recovery Center (1-click JSON/CSV export, automated daily & event-triggered server snapshots, SMTP email backups, Google Drive backup sync, full 1-click restore, and single-patient selective chart restore), (2) Brute-Force Account Lockout Protection across all login endpoints and Admin Lockout Manager, and (3) Self-Hosted VPS Database & Authentication Dual-Sync / Migration Kit for the clinic's own server.
